# Install and load R packages
```{r install-packages}
pkgs <- c("here", "ggplot2", "dplyr", "skmeans", "Seurat", "tidyr", "mclust")
to_install <- setdiff(pkgs, rownames(installed.packages()))
if (length(to_install)) {
  install.packages(to_install)
}

for (p in pkgs) library(p, character.only = TRUE)
```

# Settings
```{r settings, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

source(here("clSensitivity.R"))

#Run control
RUN_MODE      <- "plot"   # "compute" = cluster + write CSVs + plot; "plot" = read CSVs + plot only
SKIP_EXISTING <- FALSE       # compute mode: skip datasets whose CSVs already exist

# Directories
INPUT_DIR <- here("Filtered_Input")
DATA_DIR  <- here("Data_Hold")
GENE_DIR  <- file.path(DATA_DIR, "Gene_Scores")       # from step 1
RES_DIR   <- file.path(DATA_DIR, "Sensitivity_ARI")   # CSV outputs
PLOT_DIR  <- here("Sensitivity_ARI")                  # all plots together
for (d in c(RES_DIR, PLOT_DIR)) dir.create(d, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Plot appearance
PLOT_DPI    <- 300
PLOT_WIDTH  <- 5
PLOT_HEIGHT <- 4
COL_PG    <- "#1BB7D8"
COL_HVG   <- "#E55B1E"
COL_UNION <- "#2C9F45"

# Analysis constants
SEED       <- 12345
THRESHOLDS <- seq(10, 50, by = 2)   # cumulative GPS (%) cutoffs
TOL        <- 1e-6                   # floating-point tolerance for reaching a threshold

# Datasets (only those with ground truth)
datasets <- c(
    PBMCs                = "PBMCs_Counts.csv"
)

LABEL_FILES <- c( PBMCs                = "PBMCs_Labels.csv"
)

LEGEND_DATASETS <- c(
    "TabulaMuris_Lung"
  , "TabulaMuris_Liver"
  , "Human_Primary_Motor_Cortex"
)

# Axis limits
X_LIMITS      <- c(10, 50)
Y_LIMITS_SENS <- c(0, 1)
Y_LIMITS_ARI  <- c(0, 1)

# Optional per-dataset overrides; any field left out falls back to the globals
LIMIT_OVERRIDES <- list(
    TabulaMuris_Lung = list(y_ari = c(0, 0.5)),
    Human_Primary_Motor_Cortex = list(y_sens = c(0, 1.2))
)

# Legend placement
# c(1, 0) = bottom-right corner, inside the panel
LEGEND_POS <- c(1, 0)
```

# Helpers

```{r helpers}
save_plot_both <- function(plot, file_stub) {
  ggsave(filename = paste0(file_stub, ".tif"), plot = plot, dpi = PLOT_DPI,
         width = PLOT_WIDTH, height = PLOT_HEIGHT, units = "in",
         device = "tiff", compression = "lzw", type = "cairo", bg = "white")
  ggsave(filename = paste0(file_stub, ".jpg"), plot = plot, dpi = PLOT_DPI,
         width = PLOT_WIDTH, height = PLOT_HEIGHT, units = "in",
         device = "jpeg", quality = 100, type = "cairo", bg = "white")
}

read_counts <- function(file) {
  cm <- read.csv(file.path(INPUT_DIR, file), row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)
  rownames(cm) <- gsub("-", "_", rownames(cm))
  colnames(cm) <- gsub("\\.", "-", colnames(cm))
  as.matrix(cm)
}

# Named numeric truth vector (1..k), aligned to the given cells by name
read_truth <- function(truth_file, cells) {
  lab <- read.csv(file.path(INPUT_DIR, truth_file))
  lab$cell <- gsub("\\.", "-", lab$cell)
  idx <- match(cells, lab$cell)
  if (anyNA(idx)) warning(sum(is.na(idx)), " cells have no label and will be excluded")
  labels <- lab$label[idx]
  keep   <- !is.na(labels)
  labels <- labels[keep]
  levs   <- unique(lab$label[lab$cell %in% cells[keep]])   # label-file order
  setNames(as.numeric(factor(labels, levels = levs)), cells[keep])
}

file_paths <- function(prefix) {
  list(sens = file.path(RES_DIR, paste0(prefix, "_SKM_sensitivity_results.csv")),
       ari  = file.path(RES_DIR, paste0(prefix, "_SKM_rand_index_results.csv")))
}

# SK-means on log2(x+1) of a gene subset; cells with all-zero rows are dropped
run_skm <- function(mat, genes, k) {
  x <- t(log2(mat[genes, , drop = FALSE] + 1))
  keep <- rowSums(x) > 0
  set.seed(SEED)
  cl <- skmeans(x = x[keep, , drop = FALSE], k = k, control = list(verbose = FALSE))$cluster
  names(cl) <- rownames(x)[keep]
  list(cluster = cl, dropped = sum(!keep))
}

score_skm <- function(res, truth, k) {
  tv <- truth[names(res$cluster)]
  c(sens = as.numeric(clustSensitivity(res$cluster, tv, as.character(1:k))[1, 2]),
    ari  = adjustedRandIndex(x = res$cluster, y = tv))
}

get_limits <- function(prefix) {
  o <- LIMIT_OVERRIDES[[prefix]]
  list(x      = if (!is.null(o$x))      o$x      else X_LIMITS,
       y_sens = if (!is.null(o$y_sens)) o$y_sens else Y_LIMITS_SENS,
       y_ari  = if (!is.null(o$y_ari))  o$y_ari  else Y_LIMITS_ARI)
}

# Plot builder
plot_metric <- function(df, cols, labels, xlim, ylim, show_legend,
                        ylab,
                        legend_pos = LEGEND_POS) {
  df <- df[df$thresholds >= xlim[1] & df$thresholds <= xlim[2], ]   # hard x limits
  plot_df <- df %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = all_of(cols), names_to = "metric", values_to = "value")
  plot_df$metric <- factor(plot_df$metric, levels = cols)
  plot_df$label_val <- NA
  plot_df$label_val[plot_df$metric == cols[1]] <- plot_df$num_genes[plot_df$metric == cols[1]]
  plot_df$label_val[plot_df$metric == cols[3]] <- plot_df$union_num_genes[plot_df$metric == cols[3]]

  p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = thresholds, y = value, color = metric)) +
    geom_point(size = 2) +
    geom_text(data = subset(plot_df, metric == cols[1]), aes(label = label_val),
              color = COL_PG, vjust = +2, size = 3, check_overlap = TRUE) +
    geom_text(data = subset(plot_df, metric == cols[3]), aes(label = label_val),
              color = COL_UNION, vjust = -2, size = 3, check_overlap = TRUE) +
    geom_smooth(method = "loess",
                method.args = list(span = 1, degree = 1, surface = "direct"),
                se = FALSE) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = ylim) +                                    # y zoom only
    labs(x = "Cumulative GPS (%)", y = ylab, title = NULL) +
    scale_color_manual(name = NULL, breaks = cols,
                       values = setNames(c(COL_PG, COL_HVG, COL_UNION), cols),
                       labels = setNames(labels, cols)) +
    theme_minimal()

  if (show_legend) {
    p <- p + theme(
      legend.position             = "inside",
      legend.position.inside      = legend_pos,
      legend.justification.inside = legend_pos,
      legend.box.margin           = margin(4, 4, 4, 4),
      legend.title                = element_blank(),
      legend.background           = element_rect(fill = alpha("white", 0.8), colour = NA)
    )
  } else {
    p <- p + theme(legend.position = "none")
  }
  p
}
```

# Compute (RUN_MODE = "compute")

```{r compute}
if (RUN_MODE == "compute") {
  for (prefix in names(datasets)) {
    message("==================== ", prefix, " ====================")
    paths <- file_paths(prefix)
    if (SKIP_EXISTING && all(file.exists(unlist(paths)))) {
      message("CSVs exist, skipping"); next
    }

    tryCatch({
      # Inputs
      count_matrix <- read_counts(datasets[[prefix]])
      true_labels_vector <- read_truth(LABEL_FILES[[prefix]], colnames(count_matrix))
      count_matrix <- count_matrix[, names(true_labels_vector), drop = FALSE]
      k_cls <- length(unique(true_labels_vector))

      gene_df <- read.csv(file.path(GENE_DIR, paste0(prefix, "_gene_scores.csv")),
                          check.names = FALSE)

      # PG ranking: genes with GPS > 0, descending
      pg_scores <- setNames(gene_df$GPS, gene_df$Gene)
      pg_scores <- sort(pg_scores[pg_scores > 0], decreasing = TRUE)

      # HVG ranking: zero dispersion -> NA -> excluded entirely
      hvg_scores <- setNames(gene_df$HVG_Dispersion, gene_df$Gene)
      hvg_scores[hvg_scores == 0] <- NA
      HVGs <- names(sort(hvg_scores[!is.na(hvg_scores)], decreasing = TRUE))

      # Cumulative-threshold gene selection
      selectedGeneList <- list()
      currentpropsum   <- 0
      threshold_index  <- 1
      for (i in seq_along(pg_scores)) {
        currentpropsum <- currentpropsum + pg_scores[i] * 100
        while (threshold_index <= length(THRESHOLDS) &&
               currentpropsum >= THRESHOLDS[threshold_index] - TOL) {
          selectedGeneList[[threshold_index]] <- names(pg_scores)[seq_len(i)]
          message("Threshold ", THRESHOLDS[threshold_index], " reached at index ", i)
          threshold_index <- threshold_index + 1
        }
        if (threshold_index > length(THRESHOLDS)) break
      }
      thresholds_used <- THRESHOLDS[seq_along(selectedGeneList)]
      num_genes <- sapply(selectedGeneList, length)

      # SK-means for PG, HVG (top-N matched to PG count), Union
      n_t <- length(selectedGeneList)
      out <- matrix(NA_real_, n_t, 9,
                    dimnames = list(NULL, c("pg_sens", "hvg_sens", "union_sens",
                                            "pg_ari", "hvg_ari", "union_ari",
                                            "pg_drop", "hvg_drop", "union_drop")))
      hvg_num_genes   <- integer(n_t)
      union_num_genes <- integer(n_t)

      for (i in seq_len(n_t)) {
        pg_genes    <- selectedGeneList[[i]]
        hvg_genes   <- HVGs[seq_len(min(length(HVGs), num_genes[i]))]
        union_genes <- union(pg_genes, hvg_genes)
        hvg_num_genes[i]   <- length(hvg_genes)
        union_num_genes[i] <- length(union_genes)

        pg_res    <- run_skm(count_matrix, pg_genes,    k_cls)
        hvg_res   <- run_skm(count_matrix, hvg_genes,   k_cls)
        union_res <- run_skm(count_matrix, union_genes, k_cls)

        s_pg <- score_skm(pg_res, true_labels_vector, k_cls)
        s_hv <- score_skm(hvg_res, true_labels_vector, k_cls)
        s_un <- score_skm(union_res, true_labels_vector, k_cls)

        out[i, ] <- c(s_pg["sens"], s_hv["sens"], s_un["sens"],
                      s_pg["ari"],  s_hv["ari"],  s_un["ari"],
                      pg_res$dropped, hvg_res$dropped, union_res$dropped)
        message(prefix, ": threshold ", thresholds_used[i], " done (", num_genes[i], " genes)")
      }

      common_cols <- data.frame(
        thresholds          = thresholds_used,
        num_genes           = as.integer(num_genes),
        hvg_num_genes       = hvg_num_genes,
        union_num_genes     = union_num_genes,
        PG_cells_dropped    = as.integer(out[, "pg_drop"]),
        HVG_cells_dropped   = as.integer(out[, "hvg_drop"]),
        Union_cells_dropped = as.integer(out[, "union_drop"])
      )

      sens_df <- data.frame(PG_sensitivity  = out[, "pg_sens"],
                            HVG_sensitivity = out[, "hvg_sens"],
                            PG_HVG_Union    = out[, "union_sens"],
                            common_cols)
      ari_df  <- data.frame(PG_randIndex     = out[, "pg_ari"],
                            HVG_randIndex    = out[, "hvg_ari"],
                            PG_HVG_UnionRand = out[, "union_ari"],
                            common_cols)

      write.csv(sens_df, paths$sens, row.names = FALSE)
      write.csv(ari_df,  paths$ari,  row.names = FALSE)
    }, error = function(e) {
      message("FAILED on ", prefix, ": ", conditionMessage(e))
    })

    rm(list = intersect(ls(), c("count_matrix", "gene_df", "selectedGeneList", "out")))
    invisible(gc())
  }
}
```

# Plot (runs in both modes, reads from CSVs)

```{r plot}
for (prefix in names(datasets)) {
  paths <- file_paths(prefix)
  if (!all(file.exists(unlist(paths)))) {
    message("No CSVs for ", prefix, ", skipping plots"); next
  }
  lims   <- get_limits(prefix)
  legend <- prefix %in% LEGEND_DATASETS

  sens_df <- read.csv(paths$sens)
  ari_df  <- read.csv(paths$ari)

  p_sens <- plot_metric(sens_df,
                        cols   = c("PG_sensitivity", "HVG_sensitivity", "PG_HVG_Union"),
                        labels = c("Principal Genes", "Seurat's HVG", "HVG_PG_Union"),
                        xlim = lims$x, ylim = lims$y_sens, show_legend = legend, ylab="Clustering Sensitivity")
  save_plot_both(p_sens, file.path(PLOT_DIR, paste0(prefix, "_PG_HVG_UNION_Sensitivity")))

  p_ari <- plot_metric(ari_df,
                       cols   = c("PG_randIndex", "HVG_randIndex", "PG_HVG_UnionRand"),
                       labels = c("Principal Genes", "Seurat's HVG", "HVG_PG_Union"),
                       xlim = lims$x, ylim = lims$y_ari, show_legend = legend, ylab="Adjusted Rand Index")
  save_plot_both(p_ari, file.path(PLOT_DIR, paste0(prefix, "_PG_HVG_UNION_RandIndex")))

  print(p_sens); print(p_ari)
}
```
